title: fix(live-preview): reveal footnote source in edit mode
body:
## Summary

Footnote previews now switch back to the Markdown source when the caret enters the footnote range or when the rendered footnote is clicked.

## Why

Links and HTML blocks already have a clear edit-mode path in live preview. Footnotes had the preview rendering, but editing the original `[^1]` / `[^1]: ...` source was awkward once the widget replaced it.

## Changes

- reveal footnote reference and definition source while the selection is inside the range
- let rendered footnote previews move the caret back into the source
- add live-preview coverage for both cursor and click paths

## Testing

- `pnpm test`
- `pnpm typecheck`
- `pnpm build`

commits_at_first_review.message: fix(live-preview): reveal footnote source in edit mode
